card: This PR makes PeerManagerImpl's private broadcast tracker an std::optional, constructing it only when running in private broadcast mode (-privatebroadcast=1). It addresses review feedback from the merged private broadcast PR #29415 to avoid constructing unused subsystem state by default. Because std::optional retains inline storage space on the class, memory savings are minimal while requiring defensive checks across P2P message handling paths. PR #29415 is already merged.
changed_since_previous: No substantial changes to the patch; previous description already reflected this commit.
evidence: PR description: 'Make `PeerManagerImpl::m_tx_for_private_broadcast` optional because it is needed only in private broadcast mode (`-privatebroadcast=1`). A followup to #29415, requested in: https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/29415#discussion_r2620864832'
problem: When `-privatebroadcast` is disabled (the default), `PeerManagerImpl` still constructs and retains an idle `PrivateBroadcast` object in memory throughout the lifetime of the node.

risk.why: A missed null check or incorrect conditional branch during P2P message processing could trigger a std::bad_optional_access crash or inadvertently disconnect peers.

summary: Make `PeerManagerImpl::m_tx_for_private_broadcast` an `std::optional<PrivateBroadcast>`, instantiating it only when private broadcast mode is enabled (`-privatebroadcast=1`). Guard all private broadcast access paths in `net_processing` to handle uninitialized state, disconnecting peers or returning early if private broadcast methods or messages are reached while disabled.
